km-doc.km-title: SP Metropolitan Weekly Review 圣保罗都市圈周报 (BRT 9.14-9.18)
km-doc.p: 9月第二周核心结论聚焦两项：①BML改价完成率从15.2%跃升至54.1%——SPU 4,789/8,858完成，仅一周推进38.9pp，41名BD已达标(≥60%)，Tadeu(75.8%)、Daniel*(75.5%)、Thiago(71.7%)进入第一梯队；Southern城市62.3%率先过半，Western 50.3%紧追，Santos 36.5%仍需加速。②竞对独家攻势显著升级——Yellow本周以68次提及超越iFood成为第二大威胁，Western区两家商户已签Yellow独家(Bun Smash Burger(上期700K级报价)、Pizzaria Mukai)，RCD FOOD已接受R＄400K报价，Universitaria Grill进入80K谈判尾声；99在TEKAO(600K)和Olympus(46K+250K)持续施压。过程端：Metro拜访2,009次(+8.4% WoW)、人均4.7次/BD/天、线下率96.1%，Santos 5.8次/BD/天再居第一。

p.em: Week 2 of September centers on two developments: (1) BML menu price correction leaped from 15.2% to 54.1% SPU completion — 4,789/8,858 SPUs done in one week (+38.9pp), with 41 BDs already at or above the 60% threshold. Tadeu (75.8%), Daniel (75.5%) and Thiago (71.7%) form the top tier; Southern city leads at 62.3%, Western at 50.3%, Santos at 36.5%. (2) Competitor exclusivity attacks escalated significantly — Yellow (68 mentions) overtook iFood as the #2 threat. Two Western merchants already signed Yellow exclusivity (Bun Smash Burger, Pizzaria Mukai); RCD FOOD accepted a R＄400K offer; Universitaria Grill is in final 80K negotiations. 99 keeps pressure on TEKAO (600K) and Olympus (46K + 250K). Process: 2,009 Metro visits (+8.4% WoW), 4.7/BD/day, 96.1% offline rate; Santos again #1 at 5.8/BD/day.

km-doc.h3: 2 本月重点任务 Key Priorities This Month
km-doc.h4: BML菜单改价落地 BML Menu Price Correction Rollout
km-doc.p: BML改价是本月唯一核心重点任务，已连续三周为S2主板块。 9月核心项目：治理虚假折扣菜（虚高原价），对标Red完成原价校正。SP Metro任务池2,197家商户 / 8,858 SPU（全SMB总池~6,100家/~25,000 SPU），其中约75%的SPU价格高于Red 1.1倍、25%折扣价高于90天历史最低原价。成功定义（SPU口径）：①Keeta原价调低至≤目标价（Red原价或历史最低价）；②或抬高Red原价至≥Keeta价，且维持到月底最后3天。9-10月完成原价治理，11月启动折后价治理。BML repricing is the month's single core priority — three straight weeks as the S2 flagship. September: correct inflated original prices of fake-discount items, benchmarked against Red. SP Metro pool: 2,197 merchants / 8,858 SPUs (SMB-wide ~6,100 / ~25,000); ~75% of SPUs above 1.1x Red, 25% above the 90-day low. Success (per SPU): ① lower Keeta's original price to ≤ target, or ② raise Red's to ≥ Keeta's, held through the last 3 days of the month. Original-price governance Sep-Oct; discounted-price governance from November.

p.em: September's core initiative: correct inflated original prices of fake-discount items, benchmarked against Red. SP Metro task pool: 2,197 merchants / 8,858 SPUs (of ~6,100 / ~25,000 SMB-wide); ~75% of SPUs priced above 1.1x Red, 25% above the 90-day historical low. Success (per SPU): ① lower the Keeta original price to ≤ target, or ② raise the Red original price to ≥ Keeta's — and hold through the last 3 days of the month. Original-price governance runs Sep-Oct, discounted-price governance starts November.

两周进展曲线（SPU完成率）： 9.12 → 9.18 = 15.2% → 54.1%（+38.9pp，周净增3,441 SPU/4,789总量）——BML启动以来最大单周增量，完成基数一周翻3.6倍。按周均线性推算月末约82%，超额冗余充足。Two-week trajectory (SPU completion): Sep 12 → Sep 18 = 15.2% → 54.1% (+38.9pp, 3,441 net SPUs) — the largest single-week gain since launch, a 3.6x one-week multiple. Linear extrapolation lands ~82% at month-end with ample slack.

与BDM绩效系数联动（dt=9/18 Excel）： BML系数全员1.2-1.5档（BML Excel口径completed 4,547/7,724=58.9%），是综合系数的最大得分来源——Tadeu（BML 1.5档）与Thiago（1.5档）综合排名前四的基石。Excel口径58.9% vs Supabase看板54.1%的差异主要来自Daniel缺行（287家RM直管商户未计入Excel口径）。BML coefficients sit at 1.2-1.5 for all 11 BDMs (Excel-basis completed 4,547/7,724 = 58.9%) — the single largest score driver; Tadeu and Thiago's 1.5 band anchors their top-4 composite ranks. The 58.9% vs 54.1% gap is mostly Daniel's missing row (~287 RM-direct merchants excluded from the Excel basis).
